title: Man faces charges for alleged revenge porn after relationship ends
summary: A man is facing charges after allegedly distributing intimate images of his former partner without her consent following the end of their relationship. The alleged revenge porn incident occurred after the couple's relationship concluded after less than a year. Details of the charges and the legal proceedings are not specified.
